definitions.gloss: local area; hometown; one's local community
definitions.explanation: The area where one lives or comes from; the local community.

examples.english: To buy at a local store.

examples.japanese: {地元|じもと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}りたい→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I want to go back to my hometown.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{地元|じもと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦マーケット→マーケット：00265_maaketto⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I go to the local market on weekends.

notes:
{地元|じもと} means one's local area — the place where you live, grew up, or have roots. Flexible in scope: it can mean your neighborhood, town, or home region depending on context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地元|じもと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: local person, local resident
- {地元|じもと}{産|さん}: locally produced
- {地元|じもと}⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧: local business/company
- {地元|じもと}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: local cuisine
- {地元|じもと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧/⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧: to go back to one's hometown

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {地元|じもと}: one's local area (subjective, personal connection)
- ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧: region, area (objective, geographic)
- ⟦{出身|しゅっしん}→出身：03221_shusshin⟧: hometown/origin (formal, used for self-introductions)
- ⟦{故郷|ふるさと}→故郷：25466_furusato⟧/⟦{故郷|こきょう}→故郷：02733_kokyou⟧: hometown (literary/nostalgic tone)
